reasoning: Cambria Brittanicca represents the premium engineered quartz ceiling with exceptional specs (Mohs 7, 24,750 psi compression exceeding industry standards), transferable lifetime warranty unique among major brands, domestic USA manufacturing, and strong fabricator consensus as the premier option. Expert sources consistently position Cambria as the quality leader with superior depth, movement, and vertical integration.

notes: Sonnet's Tier 1 classification for Cambria Brittanicca is appropriate and well-supported. Audit findings: (1) SRC-007 (Brittanicca Block) does reference a variant product line with different Mohs range (6-8 vs. 7), but Sonnet correctly flagged this as a potential concern. The general Brittanicca product (subject of this audit) maintains consistent Mohs 7 specs across primary sources (SRC-004, SRC-006). No contamination affecting the tier decision. (2) Sonnet appropriately relied on Pool A sources (SRC-006, SRC-009, SRC-010, SRC-011 for specs and warranties) and Pool B fabricator/expert sources (SRC-003, SRC-005, SRC-018, SRC-019) which are properly classified. (3) Some report_only and quarantine sources exist in the curated library (SRC-001, SRC-014, SRC-015, SRC-032) but Sonnet did not cite these in reasoning—correct approach. (4) Reasoning is internally consistent: premium specs (Mohs 7, 24,750 psi, 93% quartz), transferable lifetime warranty, domestic USA manufacturing, and strong fabricator consensus directly support Tier 1 positioning matching the Cambria anchor definition. (5) No obvious evidence was missed—the curated sources confirm rather than contradict the classification (e.g., SRC-016 chip repair service, SRC-027 warranty resolution, SRC-025 aesthetic positioning all reinforce premium positioning). Minor note: SRC-030 and SRC-029 suggest long-term maintenance challenges, but these are consumer experience reports (report_only) not material defects, and do not warrant tier downgrade per anchor definitions.
